title: Made this tycoon game, 100% with Claude
author: recentfuture
selftext:
I've played tycoon games since I was a kid from Lemonade to Rollercoaster tycoon and everything in between, so I've finally made my own. No ads, 100% free.

Made 100% with Claude over a couple of weeks from graphics to sounds and levels with my direction. Took several rounds of amends and play testing, but now I'm happy with it.

There's 5 different levels/locations with 15 days of unique game play each.

Any questions/comments, I'd love to hear.

iPhone/iPad: [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/border-control-tycoon-airport/id6819715969](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/border-control-tycoon-airport/id6819715969)  
Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.convertcase.bordercontroltycoon](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.convertcase.bordercontroltycoon)
